svg.title: A cubic and its first two derivatives
svg.desc: Three aligned green plots show f of x equals x cubed minus three x, f prime equals three x squared minus three, and f double prime equals six x. At the shared input minus zero point six, the function is one point five eight four, its slope is minus one point nine two, and its second derivative is minus three point six. Amber tangents appear on the first two plots. The vertical scales differ.
